violent_crime_rate.label: Violent crime rate
violent_crime_rate.source: FBI Uniform Crime Reporting Program, Return A master files
violent_crime_rate.note: Murder, rape, robbery and aggravated assault reported to police, per 100,000 people. Counts only agencies that reported all 12 months, and divides by the population those agencies serve, not the full county. Left blank when those agencies cover less than 80% of the county's people.

property_crime_rate.label: Property crime rate
property_crime_rate.source: FBI Uniform Crime Reporting Program, Return A master files
property_crime_rate.note: Burglary, theft and motor vehicle theft reported to police, per 100,000 people. This is the FBI's standard category closest to petty crime. Counts only agencies that reported all 12 months, and divides by the population those agencies serve, not the full county. Left blank when those agencies cover less than 80% of the county's people.

ohio.note: Same method as the counties, all Ohio local agencies with 12 months of reports.
